{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Define threshold for QA orders
qa_threshold = 999000

# Identify and exclude QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] <= qa_threshold]

# Filter for loyal customers with completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue after excluding QA orders
mean_revenue_cleaned = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print("Number of loyal customers with completed orders (after excluding QA orders):", len(df_loyal_completed))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after excluding QA orders):", mean_revenue_cleaned)"}
